issues.title: Welcome Mat
issues.caption: It says welcome. I brought it with me.
issues.alt: Bailey sits on a welcome mat he has carried onto the couch.

issues.title: The Counteroffer
issues.caption: One now, one for agreeing to wait.
issues.alt: Bailey reaches for a treat while his owner holds the jar.

issues.title: Parcel Inspection
issues.caption: Morgan, I'm going to need two forms of squeaky toy.
issues.alt: Bailey inspects Morgan's parcel at the garden gate.

issues.title: The Slipcover
issues.caption: Technically, I'm on the slipcover.
issues.alt: Bailey sits on the covered couch while his owner holds up a warning sign.

issues.title: The Squeaker
issues.caption: I was looking for the squeaker.
issues.alt: Bailey sits beside a torn couch cushion with stuffing on his nose. His owner holds the television remote.

issues.title: A Walk on Wheels
issues.caption: I said I wanted to GO for a walk.
issues.alt: Bailey rides in a red wagon with his front paws on the edge while his owner pulls it down the sidewalk.

issues.title: Going Up
issues.caption: The elevator skips the third floor. You have to hike the rest.
issues.alt: An elevator opens onto a trail in front of an employee carrying a briefcase.

issues.title: Toast Maintenance
issues.caption: The toast is open. Just use the other lane.
issues.alt: A miniature traffic cone marks a crack in a slice of toast.

issues.title: Leftovers
issues.caption: I bought the same dinner so yesterday's leftovers wouldn't feel out of place.
issues.alt: A man and woman look into a refrigerator full of identical takeout containers.

issues.title: Soup Forecast
issues.caption: Today's special is soup with a chance of more soup.
issues.alt: A waiter holds a tiny umbrella over a bowl beneath a ceiling drip.

issues.title: A Small Addition
issues.caption: We wanted kids, but the HOA only approved one small addition.
issues.alt: A homeowner proudly shows the neighbors a tiny traffic cone beside a larger cone in his driveway.

issues.title: The Missing Sock
issues.caption: After 48 hours, we put them on the cartons.
issues.alt: At a laundromat, a worried man holds a loose sock. An employee points to a milk carton with an image of its missing mate.

issues.title: Waist of Time
issues.caption: I made a belt out of watches. It was a waist of time.
issues.alt: One friend shows the other a belt made from wristwatches.

issues.title: Room for One More
issues.caption: I invited a mushroom to the party. He's a fungi.
issues.alt: Two friends look down at mushrooms on a trail.

issues.title: Toast of the Town
issues.caption: I unplugged the toaster. It said it was burned out.
issues.alt: Two friends inspect an unplugged toaster on a table.

issues.title: Step Ladder
issues.caption: This is my step ladder. I never knew my real ladder.
issues.alt: One friend holds a ladder in a garage while the other watches.

issues.title: Hard to Find
issues.caption: I’m organizing a hide-and-seek tournament. Good players are hard to find.
issues.alt: At a park table, an orange-shirted man with a clipboard tells a joke to a bored man in a cap. Two shoes poke out from behind a large tree.

issues.title: Time Flies
issues.caption: I threw my watch out the window. I wanted to see time fly.
issues.alt: At a diner counter, an orange-shirted man holds up a giant blue watch while his unimpressed friend sets down a cup of coffee.
